question: Will the U.S. invade Iran before 2027?
resolution_criteria: Yes if the United States begins a military offensive intended to take control of any part of Iranian territory by 11:59 PM ET on 12/31/2026. Resolves with Polymarket market will-the-us-invade-iran-before-2027.
raise_if: Departure orders for Gulf embassies plus carrier moves plus a call-up at once

history.rationale: 11/07/2026, independent view 4% against the crowd's 10.5% (8.8% with the bias taken out). The question needs a ground offensive to take territory, not strikes. Trump's record since 2025 is strikes, a blockade and talks, never ground forces (ac-trump record). Taking even Kharg Island is priced at 4.5% on Polymarket. A ground move in 55 days would show up first as departure orders, carrier moves and a Home Front Command call-up; none is active today. The crowd's 10% looks like a long-shot premium on a famous question, the pattern the backtest found at 30 days out.

players.does: Keeps the blockade and the strike option, avoids a ground war that would own Iranian territory.
Avoids attacks on US ships that would give Washington a reason to escalate.
